comparison.objective: Candidate configures a robot gripper stop; PR-2200 loads a newsletter stack into a spring-raised autofolder feed table.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric two-tool torque control; PR-2200 requires one hand to depress a sprung table while the other aligns and slides a broad stack to a stop.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades a locked angle and repeated retained motion; PR-2200 grades stack position, squareness, released clamping, machine stability, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The shared need to resist a mechanism's restoring force is generic and supports different abilities and outcomes.
